purpose: Stable anchors that let Devin CLI reactivate MOIRA's nonlinear research discipline instead of relying on a 200k-token agent to remember it.

anchors.heading: ## 项目定位
anchors.summary: MOIRA is an AI-assisted 七政四余排盘、矫正星盘 project, not a plain coding project.

anchors.heading: ### 工作协议：系统自我成长的 SOP
anchors.summary: Every work unit must update the evolving system state across dimensions, maturity and computability.

anchors.heading: ## TODO 管理（JSON 化 + 脚本化）
anchors.summary: TODO truth lives in dev-docs/todos.json and todo.py, not grep or chat memory.

anchors.heading: ### Master-Worker架构与完整性审计（2026-07-09 新增）
anchors.summary: Master, Worker, checkpoints, path-tree coverage and audit logs are the current execution skeleton.

anchors.heading: CORE_THINKING_PROMPT
anchors.summary: Worker prompts must internalize formalization, quantification, openness, holographic awareness and historical-era awareness.

anchors.heading: ## 运行时设计
anchors.summary: Devin support is a nonlinear research runtime with capsule, provider adapter, hooks, skills and audit gates.

anchors.heading: ### 全 path 列表前置门（PathListGate · 2026-07-10 新增）
anchors.summary: No book text may be processed until the target book has an audited full path list with stable path IDs, source files, line ranges and verifiable locators.
